$comment: One published resource both sides render for the markup fixtures beside this file (README.md, "Markup fixtures"). Each value is in the form the REST API gives it: title.rendered as get_the_title() texturizes it, term names as core stores them (& as &), the summary as MetaRules stores it, date_gmt without its Z. The type's id and slug are a row of type-accents.json, so its mark has an accent. Topics are in get_the_terms() order, by name. The front end feeds this through toCard() and resourceTopics(); the plugin stores it with core's functions and checks the stored values are these.
